skills.name: codex-team:team
skills.description: Use Team for delegated goals that need organized execution, readable collaboration, persistent project context, evidence and recovery in Codex; also continue existing Team runs.

interface.defaultPrompt: Use $team to understand my goal, recommend how to organize the work, and carry it through to a verified result.

skills.name: codex-team:team-finish
skills.description: Use after integration Gates and independent review to audit exact final Git/artifact state and produce a non-destructive milestone result with archive and cleanup recommendations.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and close a team milestone safely
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $team-finish to bind review, audit final state, and prepare a non-destructive milestone result without archiving or cleanup.

skills.name: codex-team:team-integrate
skills.description: Use after worker handoffs are manifest-bound and handoff-ready to validate candidates, prepare ordered integration, and—only with explicit authorization—apply Git merges and run integration Gates.

interface.shortDescription: Validate and apply ordered team integration
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $team-integrate to validate handoff candidates and prepare ordered integration; stop before Git or Gate execution unless explicitly authorized.

skills.name: codex-team:team-plan
skills.description: Use when a Codex multi-task run needs a manifest-driven lane plan before dispatch.

interface.defaultPrompt: Use $team-plan to freeze and validate a manifest-driven multi-task plan before dispatch.

skills.name: codex-team:team-recover
skills.description: Use after a team phase is blocked or failed to freeze the exact useful candidate and evidence, then prepare one bounded, non-live successor recovery brief without rewriting the predecessor.

interface.shortDescription: Freeze evidence and prepare one bounded retry
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $team-recover to preserve a blocked predecessor, freeze an exact candidate, and prepare one non-live successor brief with a new fact and bounded budget.

skills.name: codex-team:team-run
skills.description: Use after team-plan has produced a validated manifest and briefs to prepare preflight receipts, runtime roots, and prompt/dispatch bundles before separately authorized Codex task creation.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare verified Codex task dispatch bundles
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $team-run to prepare preflight receipts and a dispatch bundle from an accepted team-plan manifest without creating tasks.

skills.name: codex-team:team-status
skills.description: Use to derive a reviewable Codex multi-task status snapshot and next actions from manifest-bound run artifacts and durable task facts without mutating tasks or workspaces.

interface.shortDescription: Derive multi-task status from durable facts
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $team-status to render lane status and next actions from manifest-bound facts without changing tasks or workspaces.
